measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which replaces the current homestead exemption from City of Bremen independent school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in the amount of $10,000 for certain senior citizens with a new homestead exemption of $90,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that school district who are 65 years of age or older and who have resided in and paid property taxes of the school district for at least five consecutive years, provided that any person receiving the current exemption shall automatically receive the new exemption?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Replaces the existing $10,000 local senior homestead exemption with an exemption for $90,000 of assessed homestead value from Bremen independent-school-district property taxes, including school bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. New applicants must be at least 65 on January 1 of the application year and have lived in and paid property taxes to the school district for at least five consecutive years immediately before applying. People already claiming the existing $10,000 senior exemption would automatically receive the new exemption without applying. The exemption replaces other local-Act homestead exemptions for these school taxes, adds to exemptions granted under general state law, and does not apply to state, county, city or county-school-district property taxes. Other applicants must apply to the city or its designee; it then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility. Assessed value above the exemption remains taxable.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the $90,000 school-tax homestead exemption with the stated eligibility and automatic-transfer rules.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed replacement senior school-tax exemption.
